bullets.text: Dual-Screen Delight - **Asus** Zenscreen Duo OLED MQ149CD impresses with stunning design and vivid visuals, but at a premium price.
Polarizing Phone Design - **Nothing Phone (3)** stands out with its unique aesthetics, but faces mixed reviews.
Health Monitoring Upgrade - **AirPods Pro 3** introduce heart rate sensing, enhancing their functionality as health devices.
Apple's Legal Battle - **Apple** appeals a £1.5 billion ruling over unfair App Store fees affecting millions in the UK.
Bright Projector Update - **Samsung** enhances its Freestyle projector, nearly doubling brightness for better viewing experiences.
AI Pet Care Innovation - **Petkit** launches an automatic wet food feeder that tracks pet eating habits using AI technology.
AI Job Cuts Loom - European banks may cut 200,000 jobs by 2030 as they adopt AI for efficiency.
Mastodon Grows - **Mastodon**, an open-source Twitter alternative, gains traction as users seek decentralized social media.
Tech Regulation Changes - New tech laws in 2026 address AI transparency, right to repair, and data privacy across states.
Landline's Resurgence - Despite mobile dominance, landlines remain vital for reliability during emergencies.
